reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs (p0035 liaison/General Manager, p0061 No Joint Venture) contain no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant binding the Customer, which matches the rule's preferred position ('No non-solicit on Customer').
No redline and no counterparty comment were proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered text is identical to the original paragraphs.
The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) fail vacuously because there is no covenant for them to qualify — they are not evidence of a deviation here.

'Missing' would be the wrong classification since the rule's preferred outcome is the absence of a restriction on us; the finding correctly reasons this and correctly defers the Section 6 exclusivity covenants to the separate exclusivity rule rather than double-flagging.
Rationale is well-evidenced (targeted searches for 'solicit', 'hire', 'employ or engage', 'induce') and accurately characterises the only incidental 'employee'/'agent' references as non-restrictive.
